name: SEVered
impact: Page-remapping attack breaks AMD SEV (first generation), before SEV-SNP's RMP table
mitigation: SEV-SNP introduced RMP table to prevent; BadRAM bypasses RMP
boundary_statement: SEVered (CVE-2019-9836) is a page-remapping attack on AMD SEV (first generation, PSP 0.17). It does not affect AMD SEV-SNP, which introduced the RMP table to prevent it. No Intel-SGX/TDX/TrustZone platform tag applies.

INTENT.evidence: NVD: 'Secure Encrypted Virtualization (SEV) on AMD... PSP 0.17 build 11 and earlier has an insecure cryptographic implementation.' AMD SEV first generation; SEV-SNP introduced the RMP table to prevent it.
